claim.label: maturity
claim.sentence: AMR pallet jack or lift maturity SCALING

assessment.author: editorial
assessment.rationale: Seegrid, Vecna and OTTO Motors sell autonomous pallet trucks into repeat multi-site deployments with 3PLs and manufacturers, and the category has a Rockwell-owned incumbent. It is scaling rather than mature because penetration is still a small fraction of pallet-truck hours and each site remains a project.
advance_criteria: Autonomous units as a standard line item in 3PL fleet purchases
Order-to-first-shift under a month at brownfield sites
Mixed-vendor fleets orchestrated by a customer-owned system
